correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact integer EF1 predicate on nine counts and the alternating-quantifier recursion. Every one of the 42 policy states and 126 response branches in STRATEGY.json is certified by the standalone checker, including all 74 immediate failures; every remaining fair branch reaches another policy state before turn 7. Independent exact recursion gives W6(empty)=False, W7(empty)=True. For all 3279 type streams of lengths 1..7, exact exhaustive per-prefix state propagation proves hindsight EF1 existence. The finite claim needs no asymptotic extrapolation; proofs quantify all deterministic allocator choices.

evidence: Cohen–Teh–Wooldridge 2026 gives high-probability obstructions against an oblivious adversary for variable n and O(n) goods, with four numerical values, not an explicit three-agent, three-valuation-vector, seven-turn adaptive minimax tree.

He et al. 2019 proves lower bounds on the number of reallocations required in general settings; the established 23-good example already defeats hindsight, whereas every stream through seven items for the present three vectors is hindsight-feasible.
broader_coverage.reasoning: General unconstrained online impossibility theorems do not imply existence at the first three-type threshold with this tight concrete finite horizon and an all-stream hindsight-feasibility separator. The 2026 oblivious-adversary theorem does not directly specialize to this fixed 3-agent, 3-type, 7-item boundary, and the adversary models differ. Could be undiscovered earlier specialized construction: historical-priority risk remains.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The proposition is equivalent to a winning position in a complete-information alternating choice game of item type against recipient. The reported three-type failure of one cyclic algorithm is weaker, since a different online policy might still succeed. A single fixed sequence without any hindsight temporal EF1 allocation is incomparable to the claim that every fixed short sequence is hindsight-feasible while no online policy works on all; the former does not establish this threshold.

value.rationale: A mathematically motivated exact parameter boundary: combining the published two-type online guarantee with an explicit three-type universal obstruction closes the type-count threshold. The same short arrival families remain wholly hindsight-feasible, making a substantive online-information impossibility separate from existence of offline TEF1. The 42-state integer certificate and 3279 hindsight witnesses are reproducible, nontrivial finite constructions and need no downstream theorem for relevance.
